items.author: wthompson
items.content:
First public release of shruggie-feedtools.

Features

  • Parse RSS 2.0, Atom 1.0, RSS 1.0, JSON Feed, and WordPress REST
  • Normalize output to a single JSON schema
  • CLI and GUI executables for Windows
